_meta.difficulty_scale: 1 = standard formulas, 2 = solid domain knowledge, 3 = multi-step/cross-domain, 4 = deep expertise or heavy computation, 5 = cutting-edge research-level

challenges.summary: Determine the coefficients of the holographic Weyl anomaly in 8 dimensions from the bulk gravitational on-shell action under Weyl transformations of the boundary metric.

Derive the asymptotic population growth rate of dividing bacterial cells whose growth rate switches stochastically between two states with gamma-distributed waiting times, to first order in division noise variance.
Compute the one-point function of a scalar operator in AdS3/BCFT2 using the geodesic approximation in a BTZ black hole geometry terminated by a brane of tension behind the horizon.

Calculate the orbital angular momentum and helicity of the 23rd harmonic order in high-harmonic generation driven by three time-delayed laser pulses with specified circular polarizations and OAM values.
Evaluate the derivative with respect to n at n=0 of a function defined via a Gauss hypergeometric function with parameter-dependent arguments.
Compute the Chern numbers of the top three bands and the gauge-invariant Wannier spread for the top band of a continuum model of twisted bilayer MoTe2 at the K valley.
Derive the quantum Fisher information for estimating the scaled average phase in a noisy distributed quantum sensor network using depolarized GHZ states with single-qubit dephasing.
Compute the curvature power spectrum ratio and perturbation relations in FRW cosmology with torsion via a Nieh-Yan coupling to a scalar field, evaluated at 60 e-folds before inflation ends.
Calculate the number of e-folds achieved at t=2000000 in an FRW cosmology with torsion introduced through a Nieh-Yan term coupled to a scalar field with a cosine potential.
Calculate the number of e-folds at t=25000 in an FRW cosmology with torsion introduced through a gravitational Chern-Simons coupling to a scalar field with a quadratic potential.
Compute the one-loop beta functions for the coupling constants in a (1+1)D theory of a Majorana fermion coupled to a compactified boson via a cosine interaction.
Find the phase acquired between initial and final ground states of Z_N parafermion zero modes on four sites after a four-stage tunneling process followed by a pairwise permutation.
Compute the expectation values of all Verlinde lines in a (1+1)D CFT on a torus formed by left- and right-moving edges of a Moore-Read state at filling fraction 1/2.
Find the critical coupling constant J where the boundary-condition free energy y vanishes for the n=3 random-bond Ising model on a 100x100 square lattice torus.
Compute the string order parameter of a noisy spin-1 bilinear-biquadratic (AKLT-type) chain as an exact function of system size, noise rate, and string length.
Determine the critical Hubbard interaction strength triggering a phase transition at quarter-filling of a two-sublattice tight-binding model on a square lattice.
Calculate the zero-temperature entropy per particle of a Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model with Majorana fermions in the large-N limit.
Derive the optical binding spring constants governing coupled axial motion of two dielectric nanoparticles in Gaussian optical tweezers.
Compute the maximum squeezed and anti-squeezed photocurrent noise spectra for two cascaded optical parametric amplifiers with a pi phase offset.
Derive the torsional oscillation frequency and dipole-dipole coupling rate for two dielectric ellipsoids trapped in optical tweezers.
Match a pion quasi-PDF to the physical PDF at 2 GeV using LaMET perturbative matching with DGLAP-resummed logarithms, and evaluate at specific momentum fractions.
Optimize the Holevo information over classical-quantum states built from parameterized 3x3 density matrices and express the maximum as a single-variable function.
Evaluate the one-loop sail-diagram contribution to the quasi-PDF in LaMET using dimensional regularization in the MSbar scheme across three kinematic regions.
Compute the one-loop Coulomb-gauge quasi-PDF matching kernel for a massless quark in LaMET using dimensional regularization in the MSbar scheme.
Derive a closed-form expression for the minimum Doppler factor of a relativistic blazar jet blob from X-ray cascade luminosity and photopion production constraints.
Compute the dimensionless cavity shift of the electron cyclotron frequency inside a spherical conducting cavity using non-relativistic QED perturbation theory.
Calculate the optimal Wineland spin-squeezing parameter for one-axis twisting with single-particle dephasing and spin-flip dissipation at given physical parameters.
Determine the leading Fermi-momentum power-law exponents of the second-order Hubbard correction to the paramagnetic conductivity and scattering rates on a 4D hypercubic lattice.
Derive the tunneling energy and contact interaction for the Hubbard model of fermionic atoms in a 2D optical lattice formed by counter-propagating laser beams.
Calculate the Haar-averaged squared overlap of a random orthogonal projection map between finite-dimensional Hilbert spaces in a quantum information setting.

Find the critical Rayleigh number and wavenumber for the onset of Rayleigh-Benard convection between plates with mixed boundary conditions (no-slip/constant-flux bottom, free-slip/fixed-temperature top).

Determine the critical Rayleigh number, wavenumber, and eigenfunction ratio for Rayleigh-Darcy convection in a porous medium with free/constant-temperature top and impermeable/constant-flux bottom boundaries.

Solve a system of transcendental equations to identify the Hamiltonian parameters for a three-species particle system, determine which particles crystallize, and find the scaling of the critical distance.
Compute the thermodynamic-limit two-point correlation function of a quantum matrix product state (qMPS) circuit built from parameterized two-qubit gates.
Reconstruct a 12-qubit Hamiltonian from symmetry constraints and partial knowledge of an energy eigenstate, expressed as a linear combination of one- and two-site Pauli strings.
Derive the mean-squared stochastic amplitude of oscillatory transient dynamics in an autocatalytic reaction cycle and find the minimum cycle length for oscillations to appear.
Compute the quantum metric, band gap, Z2 topology, and Wannier representability for the lowest two bands of a 2D spin-orbit-coupled Hamiltonian with hexagonal-lattice potentials.
Determine the temperature dependence of the quasiparticle scattering phase-space integral in the Hatsugai-Kohmoto model when the chemical potential crosses only the lower Hubbard band.
Derive the steady-state cavity field coherences for a three-level atom in a lossless cavity undergoing spontaneous emission from the excited state to a dark state.
Find the hydrodynamic mode spectrum for a 1D system with conserved charge, dipole, and quadrupole moments where the quadrupole symmetry is spontaneously broken.
Calculate the finite-size energy correction for a diffusion Monte Carlo simulation of the unpolarized 2D electron gas (N=122, rs=10) using a Slater-Jastrow wave function.
Determine scaling exponents for charge-puddle domain size and conductivity plateau width with impurity density in graphene on a 3D substrate, and compare with a 3D topological insulator.

Compute the fractional charge trapped at a disclination core in a 4-fold rotationally symmetric 2D insulator with ten occupied Wannierizable bands on a square lattice, for trivial and nontrivial translation-equivalence classes.
Determine the ground state degeneracy, flux-free sector count, and ground state energy of the Kitaev honeycomb model at the isotropic limit on a 3x2 periodic lattice.
Derive the condition on anisotropic effective masses in a two-band 2D intrinsic semiconductor for the thermoelectric power to exhibit goniopolarity (n-type in one direction, p-type in another).
Identify the scar eigenstates of the PXP model (Rydberg-blockaded spin chain) on a 26-site periodic lattice and compute their energies and overlaps with the Z2 Neel state.
Numerically evaluate Tr(L^4) for a Lax operator built from the Hilbert transform and a matrix-valued classical spin field with a specific wave-packet parameterization.
Analytically continue a replica partition function defined by a lattice sum with kernel K = I - (1/n)J to n=1 and evaluate the resulting function F at eta = (10/3)pi.
Solve the asymptotic expansion of cluster size in a long-range dispersal model with power-law index mu=2, retaining polylogarithmic corrections in the large-time limit.
Count the number of configurations at time t=3 in a recursive splitting-and-merging process of permutations in S_40, where all decompositions are minimal (transposition-count preserving).

Derive the closed-form generating function for the partition function of a composite particle on a 1D lattice that can split into constituent particles with g distinct channels and recombine upon meeting.

Compute the hyperangular overlap between non-interacting and Efimov three-body wave functions for three identical bosons, where s_1 is the first non-integer solution of the Efimov transcendental equation.
Determine the coefficients relating the Ricci-flat ambient metric expansion coefficients and extended obstruction tensors to the Schouten and Bach tensors in conformal geometry.
Calculate the magic wavelengths (400-600 nm) and associated transition types for imaging Yb-171 and Yb-174 atoms using the ground-state to 3P1 transitions.
Compute the second-harmonic (m=2) inelastic neutron scattering cross section from a 1D harmonic oscillator at low temperature for incident neutron energies of 1 meV and 40 meV.
Determine the smallest scalar-photon coupling that the Cosmic Explorer laser interferometer can probe at 200 Hz for a dark matter overdensity, at two different observation times.
Determine the smallest B-L gauge coupling detectable by LIGO using doped mirrors to create a differential dark-matter force, for three values of the charge asymmetry parameter.

Identify all possible magnetic space groups (BNS numbers) for a condensed matter system undergoing an out-of-plane magnetic phase transition with specific neutron scattering peaks, birefringence, and magneto-optic Kerr effect.
Compute the first-order structure factor for X-ray diffraction from a simple cubic crystal with a long-wavelength static periodic strain field, and determine the conditions for nonvanishing peaks.
Calculate the quantum Fisher information per photon for estimating a weighted centroid of two incoherent point sources imaged through a single lens, in the sub-Rayleigh regime.
Find the evolution time and success probability for quantum search by continuous-time quantum walk on a graph built by replacing each vertex of a simplex with a complete graph, at M=200.
Determine the range of phases and maximal violation of an N-slit nonclassicality inequality for a quantum particle in equal superposition across paths with a specific phase-encoding strategy.
Compute the white-noise robustness of KCBS measurements for proving generalized (Spekkens) contextuality, both with access to all quantum states and with restricted effects.
Evaluate the 5-point correlation function of three energy and two spin operators in the 2D Ising CFT at two sets of specified complex-plane positions.
Enumerate all indecomposable gauge-invariant operators of charge up to 5 for an adjoint fermion in a rank-2 U(N) gauge theory.
Compute the generating function of the Witten index of trace relations up to charge 15 in a free U(2) gauge theory with one adjoint fermion and its derivative.
Determine the quantum capacity of a private channel whose Choi operator is a Werner-state-based private state, at a specific mixing parameter.
Calculate the first derivative of the standard quantum f-divergence along a linear interpolation between two states, evaluated at the midpoint t=0.5.
Compute the contraction coefficient (supremal ratio of output to input relative entropy) of the qubit amplitude damping channel at three damping rates and sum the results.
Evaluate the trace of a Haar-averaged 4-copy operator acting row-wise on a lattice of qubits against four copies of the 3-qubit GHZ state.
